text: Back to the room where it started.
He told us this would work — bodies, agency, a Savior, everything recoverable except the will to refuse.
The first speech wins: thy will be done, and the glory be thine forever.
And the glory, it turns out — is us.
So, one thing left, because this cannot stay a story you watched: ask Him if it is true.
He answered a farm boy in the woods.
The invitation from episode twenty-six has your name on it.
